subject: english
title: There is / There are（〜がある・いる）
description: There is / are 〜の文。単数・複数と現在・過去の使い分け、否定文・疑問文、How many 〜 are there?

story.text: There is a big park near my house.
story.note: 【単数】There is ＋単数名詞「〜がある」。場所を表す語句が後ろに続きます。

story.text: There are three cats under the table.
story.note: 【複数】名詞が複数なら are。be動詞は後ろの名詞に合わせます。

story.text: There were many people at the festival yesterday.
story.note: 【過去】was / were を使います。many people は複数なので were。

story.text: Is there a convenience store around here? — Yes, there is.
story.note: 【疑問文】be動詞を there の前に。答えにも there を使います。

story.text: There aren't any clouds in the sky today.
story.note: 【否定文】be動詞の後に not。「1つも〜ない」は not any。

story.text: How many students are there in your class? — There are thirty-five.
story.note: 【数をたずねる】How many ＋複数名詞＋ are there 〜?

flashcards.desc: 「〜はありますか」— Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.

flashcards.term: 特定のものには使わない
flashcards.desc: × There is my bag. → ○ My bag is on the desk.
flashcards.hint: the / my / 固有名詞には使わない

scrambles.question: 「この町に病院はありますか。」
「昨日、公園には子どもが一人もいませんでした。」

cloze.question: There [___] a lot of books in this library.
cloze.explanation: a lot of books は複数なので are。

cloze.question: There [___] a big earthquake in this area ten years ago.
cloze.explanation: ten years ago で過去、an earthquake は単数なので was。

cloze.question: [___] many students are there in the gym?
cloze.explanation: 数をたずねるときは How many ＋複数名詞。

quizzes.q: 「テーブルの上にりんごが1つあります。」に合う英文はどれか？
options: There is an apple on the table.
There are an apple on the table.
There is apples on the table.
An apple there is on the table.
quizzes.explanation: りんご1つは単数なので There is an apple。

quizzes.q: 誤りを含む文はどれか？
options: There is my bag on the desk.
My bag is on the desk.
There is a bag on the desk.
There are some bags on the desk.
quizzes.explanation: my bag のように特定のものには There is を使わず、My bag is 〜 で表します。

quizzes.q: Are there any parks near your school? への答えとして正しいものはどれか？
quizzes.explanation: There 〜 の疑問文には there を使って答えます。

quizzes.q: There ( ) some milk in the glass. の空所に入る語はどれか？
quizzes.explanation: milk は数えられない名詞なので単数扱い。is を使います。
